milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The blue carpet trail starts at spawn-relative (2,0,1) and extends to (5,0,8). Target is set to the middle of the carpet trail at (4,0,4) with max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60, modeling that the player can see the carpet from a reasonable distance while looking toward it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The black stained glass panes are on the left wall of the house at spawn-relative (0, 1-2, 8-10). Target is the center of the most visible pane cluster at (0,1,9) with max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60, modeling that the player has entered the house and is looking at the windowed wall.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The purple wool blocks frame the bedroom doorway at spawn-relative x=6, z=12-14. Target is set to (6,1,13) which is the center of the purple wool cluster at the doorway, with max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60, modeling that the player has navigated deeper into the house and is looking at the bedroom entrance.

Uses inventory_has because mining a bed causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. Blue beds can be broken by hand (no tool required) and drop as a single 'blue_bed' item. The player starts with no blue_bed in inventory, so having min_count=1 confirms successful mining.
